name: eq-ebass
description: Low pillar sits with kick, mud scooped, attack/air kept. Finger, pick, slap, and genre directions.
notes: Precondition: Bass track selected in Cubase, insert 0 loaded per opencode/reference/eq-ebass.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Mud scoop in the low-mid (~0.35); low pillar / axis / attack manually by resolved title.
Dry by design: no send.set calls; study stays upfront.
